cards.text: Paul is writing to the church in Corinth. He's just told them his heart is wide open, and he's asked them to open theirs too. Now he gives them a command: "Do not be unequally yoked with unbelievers."

cards.question: Paul backs up his command with questions: "For what partnership can righteousness have with wickedness? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?" Why does he put these pairs side by side?

answers.text: They are opposites that don't mix
They work best as a team
They are two names for one thing

cards.text: Paul's on a roll, and these are questions you already know the answer to, like somebody asking "Is something burning?" while the smoke alarm is SINGING. Next he asks what harmony there is between Christ and Belial.

cards.question: Paul asks what harmony there is between Christ and Belial. True or false: he's pairing them as partners who work together.

cards.text: He asks what a believer has in common with an unbeliever. Then the big finish, and I can hear the drumroll: what agreement can there be between the temple of God and idols?

cards.question: After all those questions, Paul makes a statement. What does he say is the temple of the living God?

cards.text: WE are the temple, friend, and that's like showing up to work and your name badge says HEADQUARTERS. Then Paul backs it up with what God has said.

cards.question: True or false: in the words Paul quotes, God promises to dwell with His people and walk among them.

cards.text: God's words keep going: "I will be their God, and they will be My people." Then the Lord's next line starts with "Therefore," and friend, when the Lord says therefore, you put the phone DOWN.

cards.question: After that "Therefore," what does the Lord call His people to do?

answers.text: Come out from among them and be separate
Stay among them and be their light
Go up to My temple and be cleansed

cards.text: The Lord adds: touch no unclean thing, and He will receive them. Then Paul quotes the Lord Almighty one more time, and this one's a promise you stick on the fridge with every magnet you own.

cards.question: What does the Lord Almighty say He will be to His people?

cards.text: And His people will be His sons and daughters. So Paul wraps it up and calls them beloved: since we have these promises, let's cleanse ourselves from everything that defiles body and spirit, and friend, that's not a quick wipe of the counter, that's the WHOLE kitchen.

cards.question: Paul says that as we cleanse ourselves, we're perfecting ___ in the fear of God.
